heading: Band trip forms and payments checklist
lead: Use this checklist with a spreadsheet or in Program Partner. Keep a separate column for each item so a paid fee never hides a missing permission slip.

steps.heading: Before you invite families
steps.body: Confirm the destination, departure and return times, cost, payment deadline, and required paperwork. Decide who is invited and whether the trip is optional.

steps.heading: When families respond
steps.body: Record attending, declined, or awaiting a reply. For each attendee, record the permission form status, amount due, amount paid, and balance. Keep declined students off the departure list.

steps.heading: A week before departure
steps.body: Work one missing item at a time. For example, if Jordan has returned the form and paid $20 of a $35 fee, the next reminder is for $15. If Alex has paid in full but has no signed form, follow up about the form.

steps.heading: Before the buses leave
steps.body: Review unresolved items with the appropriate school staff. Confirm the final travel roster, assign chaperone groups, and check students in against that roster at departure.
